import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for transaction amounts by type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df, estimator=sum, ci=None)

# Adding title and labels
plt.title('Total Transaction Amount by Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Amount', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
